work.author: GREGORIUS. PP. XVI.
work.description: Indult LX grants violet mozzetta to the prior and canons of S. Cecilia, Acquasparta; derogations and dating clause survive. Issuer evidence: GREGORIUS. PP. XVI. at LF14123–14123; the source dating clause at LF14205–14210 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima secunda ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo quadragesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno decimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
